newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies nine issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies nine issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp on Monday said it qualified nine municipal bond issues, which will be sold competitively, for insurance.
--Kingman Municipal Property, Ariz., $4.45 million Excise Tax Revenue bonds, direct purchase.
--Mesa, Ariz., $94.73 million Utility System Revenue bonds.
--Westland, Mich., $6 million water and sewer revs.
--Centennial ISD, Minn., $9.98 million school building GOs.
--Roseland Borough, N.J., $3.67 million general improvement bonds.
--Silver Cons SD, N.M., $4.75 million school building GOs.
